Less than a decade after Europe had to confront the risks of relying on Huawei, ZTE and other Chinese telecom equipment makers for its 5G networks, it is drifting into a new dependence that is more diffuse and harder to detect. 

An M528H wireless communication module, used in smart appliances, uses NearLink technology. Credit: 如般微电子
